properties.name: rules
properties.label: Conditional requirements
properties.description: One rule per line: whenField|whenEquals|requiredFields(csv)|message. Emitted from the model's entities[].validations — not hand-authored.

properties.name: exists
properties.label: Cross-record preconditions
properties.description: One rule per line: whenField|whenEquals|form|table|theirAttr|ourAttr|where|message. Refuses when the count of matching rows in the other table is ZERO — the mirror of UniqueGuard. Emitted from the model's transitions[].requires — not hand-authored.
